source_report.retention: Complete original17-finding operational report retained privately; public fields copied, not relabelled a qualified result

findings.finding: Original Eb0.23eV/mtrap6 are a finite-T equivalent-independent-trap model, not raw vacancy electronic energy/capacity.
findings.disposition: Source-bound extraction complete; original estimates retained.

findings.finding: A metal vacancy removes one Pd atom; an empty D octahedral site is not this defect.
findings.disposition: Actual primitive stoichiometry and neutral Pd10/H1 counts checked; wrong-input refusal documented.

findings.finding: 8-Pd integrated pilot gives positive first-D binding0.130944965913681eV relative to matched bulk interstitial D.
findings.disposition: Unqualified finite-image/k pilot only; original estimate not replaced.

findings.finding: 27-Pd bulk, bulk+D and empty vacancy actually converged within the stated frozen matrix; primitive energies and geometries retained.
findings.disposition: Valid completed references, not a completed first-D binding ledger by themselves.

findings.finding: First27-Pd attempt timed out after88.84989051666667 Native core-min; vacancy+D force decreased0.936776 to0.628702eV/A in four saved frames, never reached0.08.
findings.disposition: Preserved timeout receipt and entire failed trajectory/SCF log; no numerical completion inferred from Native status.

findings.finding: Initial changed-seed launcher failed before DFT: extxyz SinglePointCalculator retained26-atom result arrays after H appended to27 atoms.
findings.disposition: Exact1.529476s Native charged; failed source epoch and partial initial file retained; calculator detached at source before atom-count change.

findings.finding: First consumer proof over-tightened saved extxyz coordinates to1e-10A despite ASE eight-decimal output.
findings.disposition: Reader corrected to5.1e-9A rounding allowance, not a force/physics tolerance relaxation. Initial failed proof and repaired real-output refusal preserved.

findings.finding: Changed-seed discriminator spent28.8807416833 Native core-min; four completed force points reduced fmax0.3568916->0.1693240eV/A, with last decrease0.00447562.
findings.disposition: Runtime cap reached above0.08eV/A. No further Native work; actual partial energy/force progress and source-bound reuse proof retained.

findings.finding: Only n=0 and n=1 were actually tested; no n>=2 vacancy calculation.
findings.disposition: Capacity unresolved; maximum tested n is not saturation or mtrap. Preferred n is only among tested configurations at a stated electronic reservoir.

findings.finding: Dominant matched k/image/cutoff sensitivity has not been run to target0.05eV.
findings.disposition: No image-adequate smallest cell or qualified first-D row established. Prepared control inputs are explicitly unrun; Root controls any next allocation.

findings.finding: Electronic H/D share Z=1 PAW surface. No ionic ZPE, vibrational entropy, gas chemical-potential or finite-T iso.mu0 bridge computed.
findings.disposition: No isotope-specific thermodynamic occupancy or direct original finite-T parameter replacement.

findings.finding: All Native work restricted to CPU7, one process/thread,2560MiB; first actual process affinity/thread evidence retained.
findings.disposition: Exact callback CPU ns, memory peaks, successful and failed results reconciled against230 Native+20 reserve<=250.

findings.finding: GPAW zero-width-extrapolated energy and0.1eV electronic-smearing free energy are distinct saved quantities.
findings.disposition: Both primitive ledgers and incremental differences reported; electronic smearing is not ionic finite-T free energy.

findings.finding: Fixed experimental fcc a3.890A and Pd outside2.95A frozen; force convergence is only in mobile D/nearby-Pd subspace.
findings.disposition: Initial/final structure, constraints, local/total spin and raw unconstrained forces retained; no global lattice/elastic relaxation claimed.

findings.finding: Completed vacancy geometry reused; interrupted SCF/BFGS history not resumed.
findings.disposition: Byte-bound seed intake and initial geometry establish completed-coordinate reuse only; unfinished SCF after last trajectory frame is lost. No full-wavefunction/in-flight recovery claim.

findings.finding: Root superseded further controls/higher-n by one<=30core-min discriminator inclusive pre-DFT failure.
findings.disposition: Stop after discriminator terminal; unused allocation returned for Root decision, no enlarged grant.

findings.finding: Last unfinished27-Pd trial gives electronic binding arithmetic0.2424368495eV, but force0.169324eV/A and absent controls preclude a relaxed binding claim.
findings.disposition: Retained only as unrelaxed progress, never fitted to or substituted for original0.23eV. Its difference from the8-Pd pilot is coupled size/k/geometry, not an isolated image error bound.
